name: Shiki to Ecchi na Kamikakushi
source:
Ordinary sophomore college student Shiki Amano was late to his part-time job. But he had a sudden impulse. He took a shortcut he'd never tried before down a long tunnel, and emerged in a secret garden. 

R-18 boys love ADV game! 

6 characters with thier own routes + 2 bonus scenarios.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102243.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
普通的大学二年级学生天野志树打工迟到了。但他突然有一种冲动。他走了一条以前从未尝试过的捷径，穿过一条长长的隧道，出现在一个秘密花园里。

R-18男孩喜欢ADV游戏！

6个拥有自己路线的角色 + 2个奖励场景。
